title: Cyrus and the Choir
author: Beatrix Vane
blurb: Wendell Dunmore, a bone-carver who hears the dead, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
